suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document the pattern for extending generated services with enriched return types: extend base class, override methods to add JOIN queries, return enriched subtypes. Reference VisitaService as example.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document the Date vs string timestamp incompatibility between generated services and existing services. Note that complex services like SaleService may need to extend BaseService instead of generated base.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: m5-refactor-sale-service review documents this type mismatch as reason for extending BaseService instead of SalesService.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add guidance for removing syncGroupId: remove generateSyncGroup() calls, change queueSync to pass undefined for syncGroupId, use FK references (entityId in payload) for topological ordering.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: m5-fix-customer-group-syncgroupid and m5-fix-customer-tag-syncgroupid reviews show consistent pattern for FK-based ordering.
